name: TF3OpenAPI day clock
description: A clock that runs in real time: at normal game speed a second of play is a second on the clock. Three ways to play: Realistic (a calendar day is 24 hours of play, the date changes at midnight), Balanced (a calendar day is one hour of play) and Transport Fever (the calendar keeps the game's own pace). The sun and moon follow the clock unless switched off. In Realistic and Balanced, vehicle wear and age follow the calendar too (models' lifespans are scaled when the game loads them; nothing is stored in the save). Uses the game's own calendar speed and time of day; both can be set back with the game's own controls. Works alongside the Timetables mod: both show the same time.

params.name: Calendar
params.tooltip:
The clock runs in real time at normal game speed in every mode.
Realistic: a calendar day is 24 hours of play; the date changes at midnight. Years take very long.
Balanced: a calendar day is one hour of play.
Transport Fever: the calendar keeps the game's own pace, so years, vehicles and costs are balanced as the game ships.

params.name: Sun and moon
params.tooltip:
Follow the clock: day and night come at the clock's hours.
As the game sets them: the sky is left to the game's own cycle.

params.name: Vehicle wear and age
params.tooltip:
Follow the calendar: in Realistic and Balanced a vehicle wears and ages by calendar years, as it does in the game as shipped.
As the game has them: by hours of play, whatever the calendar says.
